chunks: And Abān ibn ʿUthmān narrated from Muḥammad ibn Marwān, from the Shaykh — meaning Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar — from his father عليه السلام, that he said:
Indeed, Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام died and left sixty owned slaves, so he freed one-third of them; then I cast lots among them and freed the one-third.

key_terms.فَأَعْتَقَ: so he set free or emancipated

ai.seo_question: How was one-third of slaves selected for manumission in the bequest of Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام left sixty mamluks, and one-third of them were set free. It indicates the use of drawing lots in implementing a bequest of manumission when selecting which individuals are to be emancipated.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5503 - Aban ibn Uthman narrated from Muhammad ibn Marwan from the Shaykh, meaning Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as), from his father, Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), peace be upon them both, that Imam (as) said:
"Indeed, Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), passed away and left sixty servants. He freed one-third of them, then I drew lots among the remaining ones and freed another one-third."
